problem: Google wanted to focus on fewer products.
title: Google announces it will shut down Google Reader
context: Google Reader was an RSS reader with a loyal user base but declining usage, part of a round of Google closures.
action_taken: Announced as part of spring cleaning; users could export subscriptions through Google Takeout.
observed_outcome: The announcement caused a public outcry and online petitions of tens of thousands of signatures; the service was retired as planned.
observation_period: About 3.5 months from announcement to shutdown
lessons: Shutting down a small but loyal product can generate disproportionate goodwill costs.
limitations: Petition counts vary by source and date. No data on business impact of the closure was found.

claims.claim_text: Google announced Google Reader would be retired on 1 July 2013 as part of a round of closures.
Large online petitions asked Google to keep Reader.
